title: Observer Intelligence Shadow / Adversarial Evaluation
description: Isolated critic or counterfactual observer. Must declare exact information received and any correlation with the primary path. Isolation until reconciliation is required for independence credit.

observation_refs.description: Observation Record IDs the critic was allowed to see.

information_received_summary.description: Human- or machine-readable description of exactly what content was provided (raw observations, already-interpreted claims, filtered subset, etc.).

received_interpretations.description: True if the critic received primary-path interpretations or claims rather than only raw observations.

isolation_flag.description: True if this evaluation was produced without exposure to the primary reconciler's intermediate state and without shared mutable context.

estimated_dependence.description: 0 = fully independent critic path; 1 = fully correlated.

contradictions.description: Claims or observations the critic identifies as inconsistent.

semantic_leap_flags.description: Places where valid evidence appears to have been over-claimed.

support_for_primary.description: Optional: points on which the critic agrees.
